data.summary: Graph containment and header actions confused the creative workflow
data.expected: Open inside Scene. Show real visual/component nodes and one location trail, with clear navigation down and up.
data.actual: Scene and Visual appeared as sibling cards. Removing the Scene card alone left competing Scene controls and Scene header buttons.
data.correction: User requested a streamlined UX. Remove synthetic Scene card and duplicate settings/back actions. Show the current breadcrumb as text; clickable ancestors navigate up. Select nodes for controls and use canvas background for scene controls.
